confirm.title: Set up {name}?
confirm.description:
Device: {name} ({address})

The light accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time. Close the MeRGBW app (or turn off Bluetooth on your phone) before continuing.

user.title: Add MeRgbW light manually
user.description:
Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the light.

The light accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time. If it is connected to the MeRGBW app, Home Assistant cannot find or control it – close the app first.
